what: BWD-VT (2026-10-24), measured and not taken, with BWD-T-0's readings of the attention backward on SOFTMAX-T's tree. BWD-VT: in the backward's contiguous task (ATT-CONTIG's region) on the AVX-512 instance, V's slot holds the KV head's values transposed -- V is read only by the probability-adjoint tiles -- so every tile reads the whole panel and none transposes its values again for each row block (DP-PANEL's per-tile panel); every value the same. BWD-T-0: the backward a phase at a time, the GEO step a part at a time, and the backward's two kernels on cache-resident operands, to place the backward's gap to v1's rate. Records only: no runtime change.
